changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model entry and simplified output description. This paper addresses code generation (web scraper generation) which qualifies as NLG for code.
Simplified the metric list to base forms, removing redundant variants and detailed breakdowns. The paper uses traditional IE metrics plus a novel executability metric.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. LLMs are used for generation only.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. The paper states: 'Human annotations are not employed during the evaluation of our method.'

overall_notes: This paper is primarily about web scraper generation using LLMs, which qualifies as code generation (a subset of NLG). The main contribution is the AutoScraper framework that generates executable XPath expressions. All evaluation is automated using information extraction metrics and a novel executability metric. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted.
